description: Lists appointments (booked time slots) by appointment DATE, ordered by date and slot, and returns from, to, count, truncated, and items. Each item has id, scheduledDate, slotIndex, status, customerName, service, city, and source. Use it for the schedule, such as what is booked next week; use neuron_jobs for jobs created in a past period. It looks FORWARD by default, defaults from to today (UTC) and to to 7 days after from, permits a range of at most 90 days, allows a past from, and returns at most 500 bookings; truncated is true when the cap was reached. Test and synthetic records are excluded; this Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only, reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:bookings on the consent screen, and returns JSON objects also as text. The limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.

from.description: First appointment date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today (UTC); it must not be after to.

to.description: Last appointment date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: 7 days after from; it is at most 90 days after from.

name: neuron_bookings

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: List bookings
